pairs.subject: repository-landing-document
pairs.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/PassportActionsRow.tsx:153 The wall's 'Copy readiness report' action hands the user a markdown claim block (scores, '/100', 'meets the standard ✓') that the action catalog says is meant to be pasted into a README, but the block links to nothing that would go red when the claim stops holding, so the pasted claim freezes at the day it was copied.

techniques.evidence: src/features/teams/sub_factory/passport/passportExport.ts:30 The export (which its own header calls a 'report/badge' for the README, line 2) states a conformance verdict and statistics with only a date stamp (line 25) and no link to a check; header lines 3-5 admit the 'personas passport verify' CI check does not exist yet, which is 'badge before check'.

pairs.registryProposal: The subject's techniques assume the landing document is hand-authored in the repo. They do not cover a tool that generates claim blocks for other repos' READMEs, like this readiness-passport export. evidence-linked-badges could say that a generated, pasteable claim snapshot needs a link back to its re-runnable source, or else an expiry the reader can see.
